title: Linear: Configurable environments
how: ffmpeg streamed the video from its URL into cutscene's measure (256 px luma, every frame); nothing saved but these numbers and stills in scratch
whyTopTier: One continuous 12.6 s camera move across three parallel configurations (Web app, Go backend, Data service) instead of three shots: the comparison is made by the move itself.
instrument: A perspective camera over tilted UI planes: the zoom-and-pan tracker can't model it, so only the cut times stand.

byEye.zoom: tilted cards in perspective, shallow depth of field
byEye.cards: 'The right environment for every session.' ~2.6 s, the Linear logo 1.5 s
byEye.aspect: 4:3, 1920×1440, 30 fps (the only 4:3 film in the set)
byEye.sound: an audio track (147 onsets); 1 of 4 cuts on its grid

classify: 3D motion-design film: one continuous camera move across three parallel items. Conventions: tilted cards, depth of field, a claim card.

diagnose.observation: One 12.6 s move crosses three configurations instead of three shots.
diagnose.principle: A 'oner' through siblings: continuity says 'these are the same kind of thing'.

diagnose.observation: Shallow depth of field on tilted cards.
diagnose.principle: Focus as a pointer: the sharp plane is the one to read, at the cost of the rest.

teaches.text: A 'oner' through parallel items: one continuous move across siblings instead of a shot each.
teaches.setting: camera: a scripted multi-point path (not built)

critique.like: The single move turns three configurations into one comparison.
critique.wish: Depth of field blurs two-thirds of every frame; most of the text is never readable.
critique.wonder: Could a reel pan one continuous move across a row of sibling cards in a real page?
